title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Proper Dimaya in the Municipality of Dinas, Province of Zamboanga Del Sur to Be Known as Proper Dimaya National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Proper Dimaya in the Municipality of Dinas, Province of Zamboanga Del Sur to Be Known as Proper Dimaya National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Proper Dimaya tại Thị trấn Dinas, Tỉnh Zamboanga Del Sur được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Proper Dimaya
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Proper Dimaya ในเทศบาล Dinas, จังหวัด Zamboanga Del Sur ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Proper Dimaya
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay Proper Dimaya di Kotamadya Dinas, Provinsi Zamboanga Del Sur dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Proper Dimaya
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay Proper Dimaya di Perbandaran Dinas, Wilayah Zamboanga Del Sur dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Proper Dimaya

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2001/ra_9095_2001.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports, a national high school in Barangay Proper Dimaya, Municipality of Dinas, Province of Zamboanga del Sur to be known as Proper Dimaya National High School.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
